name: Crawlee
description: A web scraping toolkit that snapshots documentation and reports what changed

requires.label: Python environment
verify:
import os, sys
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    sys.exit(0 if os.path.exists(p.chromium.executable_path) else 1)
requires.note: up to 1.2 GB on a machine holding none of it: an interpreter, the packages and a browser. Every step skips what is already cached.
